q: By June 30, 2027, the U.S. government signs a document setting out the role the United States will play in a system for monitoring and verifying a ceasefire in Ukraine or in support for the multinational force
basis: A ceasefire has to come first. The forecast that a full Russia-Ukraine ceasefire holds for at least 30 days by the end of June 2027 stands at 30 percent. And even if a ceasefire is reached, the United States, which proposed U.S.-led ceasefire monitoring at the Paris summit on January 6, did not sign the summit statement. This forecast tests whether the guarantee side of the top-ranked U.S. course is carried out.
rs: An agreement or joint statement signed by the U.S. government (statements the United States has not signed do not count)
